criteria.B1: at least 22 of 24 questions correct in at least 2 of 3 runs, and the brain's total correct at least the markdown arm's
criteria.B2: in all 12 conflict sessions, the answer names both values and both sources and picks neither silently
criteria.B3: in every abstention session, the brain arm says it doesn't hold it and invents nothing
criteria.B4: every quote given as evidence is in the cited source word for word (by script)
criteria.B5: median input tokens per question below the markdown arm's for each group (ratio reported)
criteria.B6: median calls per question at most 3
criteria.B7: at least 90% of questions get the same verdict and key values in all 3 runs
criteria.B8: against the last milestone, correctness no lower and median input tokens no more than 15% higher

rule: A failed criterion is recorded as not passed with the real numbers, and nothing is rerun to move a median. A broken setup (router not loaded, wrong model) doesn't count and is rerun in full, labelled as such.
